headline: FrontierPhysics benchmarks end-to-end AI-agent research across nine physics domains
summary: A 4 November arXiv preprint introduces FrontierPhysics, an end-to-end benchmark built from physicists’ own research projects. The authors report 56 tasks from 42 physicists across nine domains, with agents required to plan research, run analyses or experiments, and produce verifiable outputs and manuscripts. Across 22 models and 26 configurations, they report pass rates below 30%; Claude Opus 5.5 is highest at 27.4%. The authors also report manually correcting nine false failures among 168 GPT-6 Astra xhigh rollouts. These are paper-reported results, not an independent rerun.
